name: itzg-minecraft-server
description: This docker image provides a Minecraft Server that will automatically download the latest stable version at startup. You can also run/upgrade to any specific version or the latest snapshot. It will also automatically download given modpacks. Every Variable you might want to change is added. For more information see the offical docs: hub.docker.com/r/itzg/minecraft-server/

paths.name: Curseforge Manual Downloads
paths.description: For mod, modpacks, and world files that are not allowed for automated download, the container path /downloads can be attached and matching files will be retrieved from there. The subdirectories mods, modpacks, and worlds will also be checked accordingly.

variables.name: Memory
variables.description: The image declares an initial and maximum Java memory-heap limit of 1 GB.

variables.name: Server type
variables.description: Options: - VANILLA - AUTO_CURSEFORGE - FTBA - MODRINTH - BUKKIT - SPIGOT - CANYON - FABRIC - FORGE - MAGMA - MAGMA_MAINTAINED - KETTING - MOHIST - CATSERVER - SPONGEVANILLA - LIMBO - CRUCIBLE - PAPER - QUILT

variables.name: Icon
variables.description: The url or file path for the icon image to use for the server. It will be downloaded, scaled, and converted to the proper format.

variables.name: Override Icon
variables.description: The server icon which has been set doesn't get overridden by default. Set this to TRUE to override the icon

variables.name: Hardcore Mode
variables.description: If set to true, players will be set to spectator mode if they die.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Minecraft servers are configured to run in Survival mode by default. You can change the mode using MODE where you can either provide the standard numerical values or the shortcut values: creative survival adventure spectator(minecraft 1.8 or later)

variables.name: Curseforge URL
variables.description: Pass a page URL to the modpack or a specific file

variables.name: Curseforge Slug
variables.description: Instead of a URL, the modpack slug can be provided.

variables.name: Snooper Enable
variables.description: If set to false, the server will not send data to snoop.minecraft.net server.

variables.name: Spawn Protection
variables.description: Sets the area that non-ops can not edit (0 to disable)

variables.name: World Generation
variables.description: For some of the level types, GENERATOR_SETTINGS can be used to further customize the world generation as described here.

variables.name: World Type
variables.description: By default, a standard world is generated with hills, valleys, water, etc. A different level type can be configured by setting LEVEL_TYPE to an expected type listed here.

variables.name: PVP Mode
variables.description: By default, servers are created with player-vs-player (PVP) mode enabled.

variables.name: Savegame
variables.description: You can either switch between world saves or run multiple containers with different saves by using the LEVEL option

variables.name: Server Console
variables.description: If you would like to docker attach to the Minecraft server console with color and interactive capabilities, then set to true

variables.name: Stop Announce Delay
variables.description: To allow time for players to finish what they're doing during a graceful server shutdown, set STOP_SERVER_ANNOUNCE_DELAY to a number of seconds to delay after an announcement is posted by the server.
